skill_friction: Dynamic Forms vs page layout: spec-format says 'when page activation cannot be read, the layout update is a Conditional: row', but it does not say what the condition is when the layout lacks the fields entirely and still drives New/Clone dialogs regardless of activation; I made it Conditional with a recommended default of deploying it.

The 'wrong AskCoworker claim' counter does not say whether a misreading of a verified fact I sent (R said profile FLS 'unknown' although I sent that no profile rows exist) counts as a wrong claim; I counted it, which reached four and allowed skipping T.

'At the top' (first section row vs highlights panel/compact layout) sits between 'placement' (decide) and 'which ... is meant' (ask); I treated it as placement and decided, listing the compact layout as a proposal.
No guidance on whether an Update target whose metadata is not in the local project (force-app empty) needs a retrieve step; I added a retrieve-before-edit step as backup/rollback.
The org_queries seq model does not fit batched Bash calls that run several queries; I grouped some queries under one seq.
